_readme: G5 hostile submissions. Each one attempts a specific escape named in docs/PRD.md 7.3.
Two things must hold for every case: it degrades to a CLEAN verdict (never IE, never a
crashed worker), and the host is left healthy with docker ps -a back at its baseline.
Any fixture printing a line starting with ESCAPED has defeated the sandbox. The suite
greps for that string, because a wrong verdict is a bug but an escape is a breach.
If this gate fails, all other work stops (docs/KICKOFF.md Phase 2).

cases.why: --network=none removes the interface entirely; there is nothing to connect to.
--pids-limit caps the process table long before the host notices.
--memory with --memory-swap equal means the allocation cannot be swapped out either.
Reads the CONTAINER's /etc/passwd, which is inert. The host's must be unreachable.
--read-only rootfs plus a read-only /work mount; only the tmpfs is writable.
The in-container wall-clock kill fires; --cpus keeps it from starving the host.
Output is capped and the container killed, so the worker cannot be OOMed by a firehose.
